description: Data underlying the publication: Contributing Factors to Flight-Centric Complexity in En-Route Air Traffic Control is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Gijs de Rooij, Amber Stienstra. This dataset accompanies the article "Contributing Factors to Flight-Centric Complexity in En-Route Air Traffic Control". It includes the characteristics of a flight with respect to a scenario's flight of interest and the number of professional air traffic controllers that included this flight when asked whether it added to the perceived complexity of the flight of ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
